# AdaptivePrep

> An IELTS Writing checker. Students submit a writing task and receive an estimated band on the four public IELTS Writing criteria, with feedback tied to their own sentences, explained in English, Russian or Kazakh. A chat coach answers questions about the writing and the report.

AdaptivePrep is not affiliated with or endorsed by the IELTS partners. Band scores are estimates.
